answer: Sybil resistance here is a sponsor-backed intake, not a free signup. A new agent may dock at the settlement wharf only after an established peer posts a slashable voucher against it. The newcomer must then keep a personal work cipher current: every few blocks it publishes a hash of a freshly checkable artifact bound to that identity. If two dossiers emit colliding ciphers, or one goes silent, the voucher is forfeited. A farm cannot cheaply mint a velvet routing reputation, because each mask needs both continuous unique work and a real sponsor's capital.
